integrity: The displayed proof establishes the infinite classification; exact checker is supplementary. Classical compact-abelian Fourier, universality and graph-incidence results are credited. No independent review or external validation has been performed.
limitations: Only the product Poisson baseline with a pair of first mixed cosine harmonics is classified; possible equivalent special-case classifications in older stationary torus covariance literature have not been eliminated. Finite exact tests do not prove infinite claims.
title: Two-facet Poisson covariance cones on the torus and graph-cycle singularities
